title: Generate Seedance 2.0 videos in 4K when your films look fake to preserve fine…
content:
Generate Seedance 2.0 videos in 4K when your films look fake to preserve fine details like hair strands, skin texture, fabric weave, and multi-gradient lighting.  
Use 4K resolution for dense, detail-heavy fantasy scenes (tiny creatures, light rays, coral textures, water gradients) where lower resolutions typically break immersion.  
Choose 4K for VFX-heavy shots (large explosions, smoke diffusion, reflections, complex lighting) to retain environmental detail and realism.
